verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's own blog describes issuing multiple keys per environment. Each key has its own access scope, optional task restrictions, and an expiration date, which is the scoped, least-privilege credential an agent needs. This rests on a single blog mention, not in-depth docs. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the available scopes and permission model, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using these keys with an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Create as many keys as you need per environment, each with its own access scope, optional task restrictions, and an expiration date.
